literal_meaning: একটি জোড়া বা বান্ডিল (one bundle or united as one)
figurative_meaning_en: United or allied, often for self-interest
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা স্বার্থের জন্য একজোট হয়ে পড়েছে।
দুই দল একজোট করে নির্বাচনে লড়বে।
example_sentences_in_english: They have united for their own interests.
The two parties will band together to contest the election.
note: Often implies temporary or opportunistic unity in Bengali usage
